demo_recording.source: Saved live JPEG frames, about 5 fps; aligned by host receipt time, not hardware-synchronized

findings: Right yaw alone moved waist clothing about 13 image pixels and changed torso texture orientation about 9 degrees
Head rod following reduced torso appearance tilt; this does not remove whole-person translation
Three-rod following combined with right pitch kept waist appearance within about 1 pixel at the reviewed peak
Repeated coordinated round trips returned close to their before pose; no visible joint separation, rod disconnection or frame exit in reviewed views
limitations: Texture orientation is not an anatomical waist or servo angle; angle search uses 3-degree increments
Three rod endpoints cannot independently specify every passive puppet joint
Only these exact vector paths are reviewed, not arbitrary combinations inside per-axis ranges
No current precise image-to-millimeter homography or full inverse kinematics calibration
Axis 4 mechanical response remains weak; its command was held fixed
Force, actual shaft angle and physical power cutoff are not measured by this software
